Business Class on long-haul routes

Feel good right from the start

With Lufthansa Business Class, you’ll reach your destination feeling well-rested. Relax before your flight in the Lufthansa Business Lounges and then enjoy the first-rate service on board. The new Lufthansa Business Class seat can be converted into a fully flat bed that is almost two metres long – just the thing for relaxing during a long flight. The open-plan design, the seating arrangement and the subtle, natural colour scheme create a surprisingly spacious feel.

inserts.replace:
Flights delayed and cancelled at short notice

We do our very best always to get you to your destination reliably and on time. However, air traffic disruptions can still occur, your departure gate may change, your flight might be delayed, or might even have to be cancelled.

{column-start}

Rapid help
Compensation
Lufthansa app
FAQs

{column-end}

{divider-25}

Rapid help in the event of delay or cancellation of my flight {heading-small limited-width}

If this is the case, we will inform you about any flight changes via email or text message or the Lufthansa app and rebook you automatically if required. Please ensure that you have stored your current contact details in My bookings.

If you have booked your flight ticket via a tour operator or in a travel agency, you can also contact the tour operator or travel agency directly.

To the Lufthansa app

In the event of last-minute rebooking

Was your flight cancelled at short notice? You can use our Help Center to check if you have already been rebooked, or choose an alternative flight yourself and rebook free of charge.

Rebooking via Help Center

Rapid help with your ticket refund

Has your flight been changed or cancelled? With our Help Center you can get your ticket refunded quickly and easily.

Refund via Help Center

Alternative transport with Deutsche Bahn

If your Lufthansa flight has had to be cancelled at short notice, and we cannot offer you a suitable alternative flight, you can convert your flight ticket into a Deutsche Bahn rail ticket on certain routes free of charge.

Information about alternative transport by rail

Baggage transfer in the event of flight cancellation

If you are rebooked, we will arrange your baggage transfer. In the event of a flight cancellation at short notice and onward journey by train or bus, we will endeavour to arrange a fast baggage reclaim. Please refer to the display boards and announcements for further information.

Travel on the ICE from lots of stations in Germany to Frankfurt Airport and, with optimal transfer times, arrive conveniently for your flight departure.

  • Advance seat reservation for the train journey
  • Automatic rebooking in the event of delays

To Lufthansa Express Rail

  • Optimal coordination of bus and flight with transfer guarantee
  • One ticket and one check-in
  • Automatic rebooking in the event of delays

To Lufthansa Express Bus
